Simplified Chinese reader locale

简体中文 — the zh-Hans reader pack. Script: Han (Simplified); direction: left-to-right.

FieldValue
Locale codezh-Hans
Native name简体中文
ScriptHan (Simplified)
Directionleft-to-right

Paired keywords (如果 / 否则) are single tokens needing pack keyword groups, and full/half-width punctuation collapses under NFKC normalization.

English ↔ Simplified Chinese#

Generated from the packs; read a row across to translate one term. The Latin column is the pack key, which keys the keyword reference.
